news.title: Fed Chair Warsh says central bank to reduce the number of rate-setting meetings in coming years
news.description: The Federal Reserve held steady on rates at the conclusion of its October meeting, maintaining its target range of 3.75% to 4%.

news.title: Oracle stock pops 13% as long-term revenue forecast and clarity on financing ease debt concerns
news.description: Oracle issued a revenue forecast for fiscal year 2030 of $225 billion, and said it will limit additional fundraising over that stretch to $20 billion.

news.title: Wendy's shares jump 15% as Nelson Peltz's Trian offers $1.4 billion to buy burger chain
news.description: Wendy's has endured a tough two-year stretch as diners eat out less often.
